products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Matrix
products.summary: 8×8 WS2812 RGB灯阵；4 MiB Flash / 2 MiB PSRAM。
limitations: 部分适配：真实ESP32-S3数字板级路径，完整应用、无线、模拟电源和实物未验收。
厂家资料、CAD和原始固件校验可追溯；未知版次、机械偏差与实际运行失败均保留。
This is ESP32-S3-Matrix SKU27119, distinct fromESP32-S3-RGB-Matrix HUB75 board.
Complete manufacturer demoZIP contains source only: no complete ESP binary in retained archive. No default firmware invented.
LED transport tests exercise actual LX7RMT registers andGPIO pulse decoder; geometry follows demo row*8+col convention, physical chain-to-position calibration remains unknown.
Published25×25mm board; rear layout/heights are unknown. Photo estimateUSB/LED depths remain explicit.
This model is a dimension/photo reconstruction, not manufacturer CAD.
Unmeasured depths, corner radii and connector contact geometry are explicit illustrative estimates; no fit, drop-in enclosure or hardware acceptance claim.
Source photographs are unchanged. Any display artwork shown in them is reference only; the live screen receives the simulator framebuffer.
Native output is64 WS2812 serial RGB values via GPIO14;3D row-major positioning follows demo convention only. No HUB75, framebuffer, touch or fabricated TF slot.
No board CAD in retained canonical ZIP/resource scope. Rear component heights, LED package depths, USB geometry and actuator positions remain unverified.
